context_requirements: Aldosterone or glucocorticoid-driven MR transcriptional activity to antagonize
Differentiated epithelial or vascular cell context; not primarily proliferating cancer lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Induction of known aldosterone/MR target genes such as SGK1, PER1, or TSC22D3 in these lines

evidence.supports: MR antagonists are highly selective for NR3C2 over glucocorticoid, androgen, and progesterone receptors, implying few off-target transcriptional effects
Finerenone acts on MR in kidney tubular cells under high-glucose/diabetic conditions, not in unstimulated cancer lines
Drospirenone inhibits adipocyte differentiation via MR, a differentiation context absent in these lines
MR antagonists prevent aldosterone-induced renal fibrosis and pro-fibrotic gene expression in vivo, requiring aldosterone-driven pathology
Finerenone reduces aldosterone-induced smooth muscle proliferation and endothelial apoptosis, again requiring aldosterone stimulation
